title: Volta Do Mar (& Matters of Leatherwork)
summary:
Kim steps forward to set a firm hand on Harry’s shoulder. “Some things are out of our control. We help in the way we can.”
Harry’s gaze drops to Kim’s hand. Before he can take it off, Harry’s arm is reaching up, crossing over his chest, larger hand covering Kim’s gloved hand.
In the shadow of broken street lamps and dim window light, Harry's gentle gaze meeting his own--Harry's a type of terror he has never allowed himself to confront.
or, Harry wears his faults on his sleeves and Kim has voltas inscribed on his ribcage to keep his at bay.
bookmark_notes: Street racer Kim (complete with the hair, glitter and crop top(!!)), revolutionary-reproduction gloves as a well-meaning gift from Eyes, glove-care and intimacy 👀👀👀
